question:
At present, calculate for the player's age who have a sprint speed of no less than 97 between 2013 to 2015.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: players age at present = SUBTRACT((DATETIME(), birthday)); sprint speed of no less than 97 refers to sprint_speed > = 97; between 2013 to 2015 refers to YEAR(date) > = '2013' AND YEAR(date) < = '2015';

prediction.sql: SELECT CAST((JULIANDAY('now') - JULIANDAY(p.XCL_125)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age FROM Player_Attributes AS "pa" JOIN Player AS "p" ON "pa".XCL_130 = "p".XCL_122 WHERE pa.XCL_148 >= 97 AND STRFTIME('%Y', pa.XCL_131) >= '2013' AND STRFTIME('%Y', pa.XCL_131) <= '2015'

arguments.sql:
SELECT CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(p.XCL_125)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Player_Attributes pa

  AND strftime('%Y', pa.XCL_131) >= '2013'
  AND strftime('%Y', pa.XCL_131) <= '2015'
